summary: Loihde Oyj, through its subsidiaries, provides digital development and security solutions in Finland and internationally. It offers AI solutions, such as analytics, Al governance, Al agent, copilot for Microsoft 365 implementation project, and artificial intelligence and generative artificial intelligence; data management services, including data governance, data-driven sustainability, data catalogs, data harmonization and migrations, and data quality management services; and data solutions, such as reportage and information platform, mapping and takeover service, and support and maintenance service. The company also provides software development consulting, including design and user experience services. In addition, it provides cybersecurity services, including CSOC cyber security center 24/7, OT/ICS cybersecurity, administrative information security, identity and access management (IAM), customer identity management (CIAM), administrator access management (PAM), information security and protection assessment, information security testing, pilot IAM mapping, cloud security, and NIS2 directive. Its cloud and connections offerings include managed cloud, hybrid infrastructure, managed network 24/7, corporate network; cloud strategy, migration, transformation, development and modernization; Information network architecture design; and Microsoft Azure and M365. Further, the company offers security solutions, including camera surveillance, access control, time tracking, nurse call and personal security, fire safety, burglar alarms, alarm transfer, access management, locking key management, door and gate automation service, maintenance services, documentation service, and administrator services. The company was formerly known as Viria Oyj and changed its name to Loihde Oyj in May 2021. Loihde Oyj was founded in 1882 and is based in Vaasa, Finland.
